---
title: "Test RegEx pakai data Carsome"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
dt1 <- read.csv("data1.csv")
str(dt1)

library(stringr)

# FIX: Ambil kolom 'Detail_Mobil', bukan 'x'
x <- dt1$Detail_Mobil 

# Gunakan as.character untuk memastikan tipe data berupa teks
split_words <- strsplit(as.character(x), ",\\s*")

max_length <- max(sapply(split_words, length))

split_words_df <- data.frame(t(sapply(split_words, function(x) {
  length(x) <- max_length
  return(x)
})), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Sesuaikan nama kolom hasil split
colnames(split_words_df) <- c("Jarak_Tempuh", "Tipe", "Asal")

print(split_words_df)
```


```{r}
library(stringr)
#remove dot
w1 <-
str_remove_all(split_words_df[,1],"[.]")
#ekstrak angka
w2 <- str_extract_all(w1,"[0-9]+")
#dibuat format numerik
w3 <- as.numeric(w2) #sudah ok
#data ok
df_oke <- split_words_df
df_oke$Jarak_Tempuh <- w3
df_oke$Tipe <- as.factor(df_oke$Tipe)
df_oke$Asal <- as.factor(df_oke$Asal)
df_oke
str(df_oke)
```
